en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a church surrounded by trees, with a lake and wooded hills visible in the background. The lower portion of the card has handwritten text, and the word 'FRÄNSTA' is printed there, suggesting the location depicted. The reverse side includes address lines and handwritten script, with a clear postal marking of '1905' and text in Swedish. The layout and language indicate it is an early 20th-century Swedish postcard.
